title: Majoor Assets Manager for ComfyUI
summary: A high-performance asset browser and management suite that indexes local ComfyUI generations for instant search and workflow recovery. It features deep metadata intelligence, allowing users to browse, rate, and drag assets directly onto the canvas to restore their exact node graphs.
research_notes: Highly optimized for privacy and speed; all indexing and search functions run 100% locally using SQLite FTS5.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from a WIP survival tool in late 2024 to a production-ready suite by early 2026. The v2.0 refactor introduced a detached floating viewer (MFV), backend/frontend separation, and optimized SQLite indexing for massive asset collections.
